title: Bo-Katan Kryze's Gauntlet starfighter
description: Sleek and deadly, Bo-Katan Kryze's Gauntlet starfighter could fend off other starships just as capably as it could serve as a troop transport. Able to carry as many as two dozen Mandalorian Warriors into battle, the Gauntlet fighter was agile and maneuverable in combat. With its wings able to rise or fall depending on its needs, it was truly a versatile ship. Bo-Katan used the starfighter from the time of the Clone Wars through to the New Republic, using it for everything from chasing down Ahsoka Tano on Coruscant to taking back Mandalore from the Empire.
